'''Maric''' is an [[Aiel]] warrior.

==Appearance==
He is very tall in his middle years. He has a bull-like chest and shoulders with cold gray eyes.

==Activities==
He guards [[Rand al'Thor]]'s chamber in [[Cairhien]].
